assets.verifiedBehavior: The recording operates the actual local Laravel app with two authenticated synthetic users. Version 1 was submitted, the instructor published feedback with revision_requested=true, and the student submitted version 2. The SQLite records were checked after the UI flow; no HTTP responses or displayed application states were mocked.

caveats: Captured from the audited development revision; this is not a statement that every shown feature is deployed to production.
All people, schools, work, and analytics figures are synthetic. Figures demonstrate the interface and are not product impact or usage metrics.

The learning-loop film is edited for pace. Idle time is removed and the longer improvement typing segment is shown at 1.5×. The caption band sits below the original UI; there is no audio or generated interface imagery.
The authoring screenshot contains a locally prepared draft using existing demo activities and teacher material. It does not demonstrate publishing or automatic classroom assignment.
AI suggestions, email, Browser Coder execution, ArcGaming, and live Reverb activity were not used or verified in this capture. External service requests were blocked.
The portfolio hosts selected recordings and screenshots. The isolated capture runtime is not deployed as a public sandbox.

screenshots.visualInspection: All six final screenshots inspected for content, composition, loading failures, and readable text.

video.visualInspection: Contact sheet plus a native-size instructor review frame inspected. Submission and feedback text remain readable.

depthReview.revisionEquivalence: Ten files changed between captured runtime and final audited dev: deployment/CI/documentation plus browser-test wait timing. Product UI/domain source is unchanged. The original checkout advanced externally during this audit and was not edited by the capture agent.

caveats: All records are synthetic; 26 fixture activities were tagged to exercise real rule-based syllabus selection.
Captured runtime is 43dfaf6; final dev audit is 5549bf9. The intervening changes affect deployment and test timing, not product UI/domain code.
Live quiz uses built-in polling fallback. WebSocket transport was not exercised.
The authoring film uses an administrator in the actual builder. It does not test all content-manager permission combinations.
Smart Build ranks existing activities. It is not AI-generated pedagogy, and preferred types are not exclusive filters.
The sample draft has missing teaching materials; the film deliberately shows the readiness review and does not publish or assign it.
Five themes were exercised. The 21-value canonical task catalogue is not a claim that 21 equivalent editors were runtime-tested.
Starting a new diagram version opened a blank editor in the observed run; earlier submitted versions remained readable.
No external service calls, production data, generated UI or UI text replacement are included.

verification.summary: Native theme changes, matching completion and version readback, diagram construction/submission, instructor-controlled two-student quiz, and smart-draft generation/rename/coverage/preview were exercised.
